values.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing or invalid quorum endorsements, signer unavailability, stale membership, domain/index/time mismatch, incomplete protocol checkpoint, rollback, retry conflict, legacy direct authority, corruption, unsafe paths, zero-test proof, source drift, or unresolved review findings.
